question: Table B at full width with less per row. A: one column per field. B: no avatars. C: three columns, the rest in a detail row. Which feels right?

variants.label: One line per cell
variants.changes: Stacked cells split into six columns (project, owner, status, progress, budget, updated), one line each. Everything else is B.

variants.label: No avatars
variants.changes: Owner avatars removed. The owner stays as a quiet line under the project. Everything else is B.

variants.label: Fewer columns
variants.changes: Only project, status and budget show. Owner, progress and updated open in a detail row from the chevron.
